name: Tesamorelin
description: Synthetic 44-amino-acid GHRH analogue with a hexenoyl group attached, given by injection

status.studiedFor: HIV belly fat, liver fat, memory

note.text: A 22-person pilot found no significant change in sleep. Two planned sleep trials were withdrawn before enrolling anyone.

bullets: **Binds GRF receptors** with potency like natural GRF, in vitro (label)
**Pituitary releases** the body's own growth hormone, per the label
**IGF-1 rose** by about 107 ng/mL in the approval trials
**For sleep,** no effect or mechanism is established
Approved in 2010 for HIV belly fat (Egrifta)

practical.halfLife: 11 minutes (single dose under the skin, label)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak in about 0.15 hours; bioavailability under 4%

regulatory.text: Approved (Egrifta, 2010) for HIV belly fat only

references: FDA, Egrifta WR prescribing information (DailyMed), Mar 2025
Stewart et al., eNeurologicalSci, low-dose tesamorelin pilot, Sep 2026
